'''Patricia''' is a Troupe of Fools member who can be found speaking with [[Claudio]] about their next performance.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Patricia:''' I suspect we'll head for [[Lilyland]] next.
:'''Claudio:''' I'd wager that [[Septimont]] is more likely.
:{{DIcon}}: What are you doing?
:'''Claudio:''' We're debating our next destination. We're still on a Pan-Ragunna Tour, after all.
:'''Claudio:''' The Captain often says, "Wherever the applause calls, there we'll go to 'capture laughter.' With our craft, our wit, and a touch of our own flair, we'll claim what's rightfully ours."
:'''Patricia:''' True enough. But each island has its own tastes when it comes to theater. We'll need to tailor our efforts to make sure everyone feels the journey was worthwhile!
:'''Claudio:''' But, whether we head to the Lilyland's Sea of Flowers or the exhilarating spectacles of Septimont, it's up to the captain to decide!
{{Dialogue End}}
